com.elo.device

Class DeviceManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.elo.device.DeviceManager

  • public class DeviceManager
extends java.lang.Object
    This manager class provides methods by which an application can interact with the the Elo Peripherals. There are getter methods which return helper classes associated with particular peripherals. Use these helpers to invoke the peripheral-dependent methods. The Device Manager is designed to work across the spectrum of Elo PayPoint and I-Series models. When an instance is requested, it configures itself to work with the running environment. You can call getPlatformInfo() to discover the platform, and pass it in to the instance getter. Alternatively, you can use the no-parameter version which does the discovery itself. To get more information about the running environment, you can use the getInventory(Context) method. Please see the Inventory class for more information.

      • getPrinter

        public Printer getPrinter(int baudRate)
        This method returns the default printer for the platform configured The printer is assumed to be operating at baud given by input baudRate and connected at /dev/ttyUSB1. Because the printer's internal baud rate can go out of sync with the system's port's baud rate, it is not recommended to specify a rate other than the default.
        Parameters:
        baudRate - Requested baud rate
        Returns:
        Printer helper

      • getPrinter

        public Printer getPrinter(int baudRate,
                          java.lang.String printerPath)
        This method returns the default printer for the platform configured The printer is assumed to be operating at baud given by input baudRate and connected at the device of the specified path. Because the printer's internal baud rate can go out of sync with the system's port's baud rate, it is not recommended to specify a rate other than the default.
        Parameters:
        baudRate - requested baud rate
        printerPath - path of the printer device, in Linux format
        Returns:
        Printer helper

      • getScale

        public Scale getScale()
               throws UnsupportedPeripheralException
        This method will return the Default Weighing Scale for the platform. Currently, there is no SDK-based support for the weigh scale. This method will unconditionally throw UnsupportedPeripheralException. For connecting a weigh scale, it is recommended that the FTDi interface be used, and that the weigh scale be connected to the FTDi's serial connector.
        Returns:
        Throws:
        UnsupportedPeripheralException
